name: Why is cabinet leveling critical for countertop projects in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Why is cabinet leveling critical for countertop projects in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners across Denver and surrounding communities often deal with settling in older bungalows, mid-century homes, and expansive clay soils that shift foundations. When house movement creates unlevel base cabinets or uneven drywall framing along kitchen perimeters, placing rigid stone can lead to cracked joints. An experienced local remodeling contractor will evaluate your wall straightness and level cabinet boxes with shims and framing adjustments before countertops arrive, preventing slab stress and guaranteeing clean, tight joints.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver area soil expansion and foundation settling often leave floors and walls out of square. Base cabinets must be carefully leveled before heavy stone is set to prevent joint cracks.
